## Published FAQ
- Q: What can the SaaS owner demo do?
  A: You can add and edit sample customer accounts, filter by status, and review seats and simulated recurring revenue. The owner demo is public and uses browser storage.
- Q: Can I adapt Folidock for my own product?
  A: Yes. The source is available as an MIT-licensed GitHub template. Replace the sample data and add your own authentication and integrations before using it with real customers.
- Q: Who is this for?
  A: For founders and B2B teams who want to manage relationships and outbound together.
- Q: Does the demo send emails?
  A: Campaigns use fictional contacts and simulated sending. Create drafts and edit sequences to explore the workflow.
- Q: Where are changes saved?
  A: The demo saves changes in this browser when local storage is available. Campaign edits, pipeline changes, and reply drafts stay on this device.
